terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: Spring Boot API on :8080 (SQLite at /data/pigeon-pod.db). Touches resources first so Flyway migrations and i18n bundles reach the classpath despite zero-mtime checkouts.
terminals.command: cd backend && find src/main/resources -type f -exec touch {} + && SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL='jdbc:sqlite:/data/pigeon-pod.db?journal_mode=WAL&synchronous=NORMAL&cache_size=10000&temp_store=memory&busy_timeout=3000' mvn spring-boot:run

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server on :5173, proxies /api and /media to the backend on :8080.
